items.title: Dragging Nets
items.caption: A screen showing how moving nets from one category to the other should work. This is one of multiple screens that show different states. Since the interaction was a bit hard to understand from still screens, I shipped a fully functional clone using Claude Artifacts to let team members test it and give feedback, and to assist devs.

items.title: Custom macOS Icon for Ghostty Terminal
items.caption: I use Ghostty exclusively for Claude Code, so I made two custom icons, each a hybrid between the Ghostty icon and the Claude Code mascot. This made it easier for me to find the app in the Dock.

items.title: App Icons for Design Ruler
items.caption: Three icons for Design Ruler, main, and one per tool: measuring and alignment guides. Each sits on the same blueprint grid so they read as one set.

items.title: PCB Cube
items.caption: A rubik cube design I made for DeepPCB to be given away in events. Turned out to be super hard to solve! I've only met two people who managed to solve it.

items.title: AI Suggestions for Net Classes
items.caption: This screen shows how AI suggestions would land and be previewed next to existing content.

items.caption: A tool to help find and link sources, and to suggest text edits to research papers.

items.title: Icon Set for PCB Objects
items.caption: A set of icons for the objects a board is made of: pads, traces, vias, components, keepouts, ratlines... Drawn flat and in the layer colours the editor already uses, so an icon and the thing it points at match.

items.title: Cooper Intro
items.caption: I created this playful video to introduce Cooper internally to the whole team. I couldn’t present it myself, as my baby boy was born the day before the presentation, so I missed their reaction, I was witnessing something far more magical.
